affine_order.note: An affine transform is six numbers [a, b, c, d, e, f]: x' = a*x + c*y + e, y' = b*x + d*y + f.

alignment_bytes.note: Payload sections of envelope binaries start on this boundary.

color_component_range.note: RGB, CMYK and gray components and every opacity and tint are 0 to 1; Lab is L 0..100, a and b about -128..127 (D50).

color_space_rgb_default.note: RGB values are sRGB unless the structure node's `color_profiles.rgb` names another profile.

curve_representation.note: A path is a list of anchors, each a point p with an incoming handle `in` and an outgoing handle `out`; the segment from anchor A to the next anchor B is the cubic Bezier A.p, A.out, B.in, B.p.

endianness.note: Every envelope binary is little-endian. MessagePack header integers inside an envelope are big-endian by MessagePack's own definition (spec/layouts/ENVELOPE.layout.txt section 4).

fill_rule_default.note: An absent fill rule is the non-zero winding rule; `EvenOdd` is the even-odd rule.

gray_polarity.note: A gray colour's `k` is ink: 0 is white, 1 is black.

handle_coordinates.note: Handles are absolute positions, not offsets; an absent handle equals its anchor's point.

hash_algorithm.note: Every files[].sha256, every input_hash, license.sha256, and spec_sha256.

length_unit.note: Every coordinate and length is in points.

number_format.note: Numbers are the shortest decimal that parses back to the same IEEE 754 value; colour components, opacities and gradient offsets are binary32, everything else binary64.

paint_order.note: Lists of layers, of children and of appearance items paint in order: the first is at the bottom.

pixel_origin.note: Row 0 of an image is its top row; an image object's transform maps pixel (0,0)-(width,height) into the document.

signature_algorithm.note: SIGNATURE.json only. Refusing it is the 'unverified' state, not damage.

stroke_miter_limit_default.note: An absent miter limit is 10 (the ratio of miter length to stroke width past which a miter join is bevelled).

text_encoding.note: Every text and JSON payload, INCLUDING MANIFEST.json - which is why the scope is container.

text_tracking_unit.note: Tracking and manual kerning are thousandths of an em.

time_base.note: The metadata's created and modified dates are seconds since 1970-01-01T00:00:00Z.

units_per_inch.note: One unit is 1/72 inch: 72 units = 25.4 mm.

y_axis.note: y grows DOWNWARD: the top edge of a rectangle is its smaller y.

note: The machine-readable convention to node-type map of profile vector-art/1 (SPEC.md section 10.2, ruling S-17). The convention set is a property of the PROFILE, not of the reader (S-25): check these and no others.
